about: Rubric for tools/narration/judge_takes.py --rubric: the judges' brief, and the criteria each take is scored on from 1 to 10, each saying what a 10 means. The tool always adds its own exact-words check. The judges assist a listen; a person chooses the voice.
brief: You are choosing the narrator of a short film that opens a unit on a play, for students aged 14 to 15. Every take reads the same passage. Judge only what you hear.

criteria.intelligibility: every word is clear at normal listening volume, names included
criteria.pacing: brisk enough for the film's length limit without hurrying any word; pauses help meaning and none drag
criteria.naturalness: no robotic prosody, glitches, clipped words or audio artefacts
criteria.register: the delivery suits the passage and the age group, without exaggeration or character voices
